annotations.title: Confirm order request with emailed code

description: Confirm an order request with the 6-digit code the buyer received by email, plus order_number and order_secret from place_order. Use it after place_order, when the buyer tells you the code. Do not call it without a code from the buyer; never guess it. Returns status: verified (sent to the manager), already (was confirmed before), invalid (wrong data; attempts_left shows how many tries remain), locked, expired (call resend_code); plus a message. 8 attempts per order request in total (a resent code does not reset them). After confirmation the request goes to a manager; no payment is taken.

code.description: The 6-digit confirmation code from the email the buyer received, digits only, e.g. "482913". Ask the buyer for it; never guess (8 attempts per order request).

order_number.description: order_number from the place_order reply: a positive integer, e.g. 1042.

order_secret.description: order_secret from the place_order reply: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Pass it exactly as received; it is shown only in that reply, so keep it for this conversation.
